gen-gf-autour-one-gf-parkinsans: Autour One lets each round letter slide in through a clear channel, loud and a bit theatrical. Parkinsans follows with one stroke thickness throughout, crisp and modern, a plain sans that keeps its footing.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-imperial-aram: Futuristic from the first glyph, Audiowide spaces its tile-like letters wide apart. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic sits below with open, pincer-shaped c curves and a short step up to the capitals, so the loud top line gets a friendlier follow-through.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-sc: Eater has a dark, ragged menace, with thin strokes loosely trailing beside its moderately weighty stems. And Noto Sans SC gives that menace somewhere to rest, since its modern sans-serif lowercase barely lifts its ascenders above the x-height.
gen-almendra-display-fs-quicksand: Almendra Display has a pronounced x-height and letters that never seem to pinch shut, which gives it an ornate, storybook feel. Quicksand's wire-like line makes the best partner.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point reads like a marker-drawn plain sans, with bulky lowercase and gaps clearly open in c, e, s and a. Grandstander's tall x-height loudness matches it well.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-vend-sans: Gugi is tall, bold and oddly cut, with lowercase nearly reaching the capitals and open terminals. Vend Sans would read like a ruler-drawn line, its wide terminals and full x-height carrying paragraphs smoothly.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-stack-sans-text: Metamorphous looks commanding and roomy, with a high midline and gently thinning arches. Stack Sans Text then reads in a marker-like single weight, its big lowercase and well-spaced curve endings making a long passage move easily.
gen-gf-offside-gf-tiktok-sans: Offside is wide-tracked and level, with curves that refuse to close. TikTok Sans pushes its x-height up near the capitals and opens the c generously, which gives the pair a shared, spacious confidence despite their very different jobs.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-ubuntu-sans: Commanding up top, Oxanium sets a big-looking lowercase in uninterrupted monoline strokes. And Ubuntu Sans takes the quieter job, its tubular, copper-pipe strokes and large open eyes carrying the text while Oxanium handles the announcements.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-yaldevi: Commanding and expressive, Paprika scatters its letters wide, its lowercase filling the line like capitals. Yaldevi answers with an e whose eye opens clearly to the right, and its outsized lowercase keeps pace with that big heading.
